# พรพรร Bright Tone-Up Moisture Cream

> Official product website for พรพรร, featuring WSWSS Bright Tone-Up Moisture Cream, a Korean-made 4-in-1 tone-up, moisture, primer and whitening cream.

## Overview

พรพรร is the primary Thai consumer brand. WSWSS Bright Tone-Up Moisture Cream is its 50 g facial tone-up and skincare product, manufactured in South Korea by PROYOU COSMETICS CO., LTD. This website is the official source for product information, manufacturing standards shown on the site, and purchasing through the official LINE channel.

## Official resources

- [Thai product page](https://www.wswss.com/): Official Thai-language product page.
- [English product page](https://www.wswss.com/en/): Official English-language product page.
- [Korean product page](https://www.wswss.com/ko/): Official Korean-language product page.
- [Official LINE order channel](https://lin.ee/sGY1qQP): Ordering and official updates.
- [XML sitemap](https://www.wswss.com/sitemap.xml): Crawlable list of official public pages.

## Product facts

- Product: พรพรร Bright Tone-Up Moisture Cream
- Primary brand: พรพรร
- Product line / international name: WSWSS
- Category: Korean tone-up and facial skincare cream
- Key functions: Tone-Up (ผิวดูกระจ่างใสอย่างเป็นธรรมชาติ), Moisture (ช่วยเติมความชุ่มชื้น), Primer (ช่วยเตรียมผิวก่อนแต่งหน้าและเบลอรูขุมขน), Whitening (ช่วยให้ผิวดูกระจ่างใส)
- Net content: 50 g
- Country of manufacture: South Korea
- Manufacturer: PROYOU COSMETICS CO., LTD. (㈜프로유화장품)
- Thai cosmetic notification number: 10-2-6800028677

## Manufacturing and product guidance

- The website displays factory-standard documents for ISO 22716 (Cosmetics GMP), ISO 9001 (Quality Management), and ISO 14001 (Environmental Management).
- These standards describe the manufacturer's documented factory standards shown on the website; they are not a claim of product certification beyond the displayed documents.
- The official product information does not state sunscreen protection or an SPF value for this product.
- Product availability, price, and promotions should be confirmed through the official product page or official LINE order channel.
